admission.justification: Panel and plugin controls jointly preserve the developer’s selection, with direct selection/focus/copy-call assertions guarding this collection boundary.

applicability: Panel/chat selection offers and the tray’s collection/open controls, with explicit text editing outside the collection action.
conditions: Offer/add/open mousedown prevents the default focus transfer; adding does not clear the browser selection.
Copy on highlight defaults on and is kept per browser origin; disabling it suppresses the native copy request.
The native copy call’s failure is ignored and does not replace clipboard content or prevent offering the pick.
exclusions: Intentional focus for note or message editing is not a collection control action.
The tests exercise copy calls and selection logic, not a real OS clipboard guarantee.
